    The homotopy category of an additive category is algebraic #

    With the degreewise split exact structure, CochainComplex C ℤ is a Frobenius exact category whose projective-injective objects are the contractible complexes (Keller, Chain complexes and stable categories, Section 1). The quotient functor to the homotopy category kills exactly the morphisms factoring through a contractible complex, which are the null-homotopic ones, and sends a degreewise split conflation to the distinguished triangle of CochainComplex.trianglehOfDegreewiseSplit, whose connecting morphism is natural. Hence HomotopyCategory C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) is an algebraic triangulated category.
